option_relations.rationale: The description of the tumor, including its multilocular spaces and solid tumor with a chalky-white cut surface, matches the characteristics of bullous pilomatricoma.
Epidermal inclusion cyst does not match the histological examination findings of basophilic cells and shadow cells.
Pilomatricoma is a broader term that encompasses bullous pilomatricoma, but the specific characteristics of the tumor in the vignette point towards bullous pilomatricoma.
Dermatofibroma does not match the histological examination findings and the overall description of the tumor.
